title: hone protocol 1: common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by the artifact, configuration, and event schemas. The base URL in $id is a placeholder until the domain is settled.

Key.description: Identifier in lowercase with hyphens: names of kinds, roles, steps, and profiles.

Random.description: Random part of an ID: exactly 8 characters of lowercase Crockford Base32 (40 bits). The alphabet omits i, l, o, and u.

Id.description: ID of an artifact: prefix of the kind (`kinds.<type>.id_prefix`), hyphen, random part. Never changes. The slug lives only in the file name, never in the ID.

Hash.description: SHA-256, always with prefix. The prefix also prevents a digits-only value from being read as a number.

Date.description: Calendar day according to ISO 8601. Always a string, never a date type of the parser.

Name.description: Handle of an author or a person. Free-form, not empty.

CodeRef.description: Reference into code: optionally `repo:` (a repository name the tool resolves locally), then a path relative to the repository root (without `:`, so that `repo:` stays unambiguous), optionally with #symbol. Whether it resolves is checked by a language plugin.

Anchor.description: Where an artifact lives in code. Every kind may have anchors. Paths are relative to the repository root, optionally prefixed with `repo:`. A symbol anchor has the form path#symbol.

Links.description: Forward links only. The tool computes backward links. Custom link types live in the namespace x-<name>. Unknown keys without x- are preserved, and the gate schema-valid reports them as a warning.

affects.description: IDs of anchored artifacts (for example modules) that this artifact deliberately binds.

code.description: References into code, including test code.

verifies.description: IDs of the artifacts whose criteria are checked. Artifact IDs only, test code goes under `code`.

transcript.description: URLs of agent transcripts. Transcripts are only linked, never stored.

proof.description: Free field for a proof (for example a signed approval or a confirmation from the server). The protocol does not define its content. `approvals-valid` with `require_proof: true` requires it.

SummaryItem.description: An entry of the condensation: a question with an answer, or a rejected alternative with a reason.

Review.description: Condensed review history. Written by the tool on completion and not part of the content hash. With `review_summary: approvals-only`, `summary` is absent.
